slides.texte_overlay:
Texting rules every grown man
should follow

1. Reply within a day

"Just saw this" works once.
Not every time.

2. Never text angry

Write it. Don't send it.
Read it tomorrow.

3. Call when it matters

Bad news, big news,
an apology. Use your voice.

4. Send something worth reading

A good article, a funny fact,
something you learned today.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Send something worth reading

A good article, a funny fact,
something you learned today
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. No "k"

One letter says:
you're not worth a word.

6. Voice notes under a minute

Nobody wants a podcast
about your day.

7. Don't leave people on read
on purpose

Games are for kids.
